title: Software Engineer - Microservices
description:
Designed the end-to-end architecture for migrating Air New Zealand’s learning management system to a new platform. Built event-driven integrations between the platform and internal systems using AWS serverless patterns.

- Modernized Java-based microservices as Python AWS Lambda functions.
- Established Lambda deployment patterns in Azure DevOps pipelines using AWS SAM templates.
- Designed observability and alerting with OpenTelemetry (OTel) Lambda layers, Amazon CloudWatch, and SNS notifications.
- Added support for invoking Lambda functions through Kong API Gateway.

title: Cloud Support Engineer (Kubernetes and Container Service)
description:
Delivered expert technical support for AWS container services to enterprise customers running regulated and high-traffic workloads, specializing in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS).

- Diagnosed performance degradation and reliability issues in containerized applications and production workloads.
- Advised customers on EKS and ECS architecture, cluster scaling, cost optimization, reliability, and security best practices.
- Supported large-scale Kubernetes clusters, helping maintain stability, resource efficiency, and alignment with AWS Well-Architected principles.
- Reduced time to resolve production-critical incidents through rapid triage, cross-team escalation, and clear real-time customer communication.
- Worked with AWS engineering and service teams to investigate product defects, develop workarounds, and advocate for customer-focused improvements.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Contributed to the development and deployment of **Blueshift**, a cloud-native financial risk management product.

- Developed Java microservices and REST APIs for market data processing, following maintainable coding standards.
- Profiled and performance-tested services, reducing latency from 1,000 ms to 10 ms through Java concurrency, caching, and algorithmic improvements.
- Built end-to-end release management scripts in Python and CI/CD pipelines, reducing product release time by 10×.
- Automated AWS resource provisioning and management with Bash, Python, and CloudFormation, including EKS, API Gateway, Cognito, S3, Lambda, ElastiCache/Redis, and MSK.
- Integrated Amazon CloudWatch to monitor application health and status.
- Identified and remediated security issues in application code and infrastructure.
- Improved user-facing functionality using React and Redux.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Designed and developed an **Execution Management System** that routes market orders to FIX market gateways.

- Built APIs and user interfaces for real-time order management.
- Worked with architects and business stakeholders on design decisions to reduce latency and improve system scalability.
- Integrated SBE encoding and Java concurrency to improve execution performance.
- Added a statistics collector to measure real-time system performance.

title: Software Engineer
institution: Axiata Digital Labs, Colombo, Sri Lanka
description:
Developed distributed applications, microservices, and REST APIs for subscriber-charging transactions at a major telecommunications service provider, using Java and Spring Boot.

- Modernized legacy applications with updated designs and engineering best practices, improving code quality and fixing vulnerabilities and defects.
- Migrated applications from on-premises servers to AWS EKS with minimal disruption to revenue-generating services.
- Managed CI/CD pipelines and applied DevOps practices to support faster, reliable application delivery.
- Migrated 10 million customer transaction records from an on-premises Oracle database to AWS RDS.
- Led technical sessions on Test-Driven Development (TDD) and helped teams apply it in day-to-day development.
- Provided L3 production support for applications on on-premises servers and Kubernetes clusters, including participation in critical incident response.
- Worked within CMMI-aligned processes and Agile delivery practices.
